description: This file defines the HashBasedPlacementDirector class which implements the IPlacementDirector interface. The class contains logic to place activations on silos based on a hash of the target's grain identity, with deterministic sorting and optional placement hints.

classes.name: HashBasedPlacementDirector
classes.description: Implements a deterministic hash-based placement strategy for activations within the Orleans runtime, using silo compatibility and optional placement hints.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the suitable silo for placing a new activation based on hashing the grain identity and considering placement hints.
